core_obligations: Transitions: for d dividing d prime the quadruple (d prime, pi_d, L_d^{tensor d prime/d}, psi^d restricted) determines a canonical morphism U_d to U_{d prime} over S corresponding to the functor transition.
Open immersions: over every affine open the base-changed transitions are inclusions of opens in Proj(A), so U_d to U_{d prime} is an open immersion.
Choose a divisibility sequence d_1 | d_2 | ... catching every positive integer and set X = union of the U_{d_i}; X represents F.
proof_roadmap: Build the transitions, prove the open-immersion property by base change to affines, glue along the cofinal sequence, and assemble representability.
difficulty_reason: Transition morphisms and the affine open-immersion identification carried in-span; the final representability assembly compresses to a named in-chapter template.
